data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is an artifact of a tool error. The qwen model failed to process the PKGBUILD due to an HTTP 400 API error, resulting in an 'inconclusive' status, while the deepseek model successfully reviewed it and found no security issues.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review the PKGBUILD due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for LLM API errors (like HTTP 400) to prevent incomplete audits from skewing the final verdict.
When aggregating results, distinguish between 'inconclusive due to tool error' and 'inconclusive due to security ambiguity' so that a successful review by another model can resolve the verdict.
